records.question: How long does Spotify hold on to my personal information?
records.text: Spotify retains your personal information for as long as necessary to provide the Spotify Service and for legitimate business purposes. For example, personal data you input as part of search queries is deleted after 90 days. Some data, like your Spotify username and profile information, is kept until your account is deleted. Streaming history is retained for the life of the account to provide personalized recommendations and features like Your Time Capsule or Your Summer Rewind [Spotify – 6. Data retention].

records.question: Will Spotify give my money back if I cancel partway through a subscription period?
records.text: Spotify does not provide refunds or credits for any partial subscription periods, except as expressly stated in these Terms [Spotify – Billing and cancellation].

records.question: Can I team up with other Spotify customers to sue the company as a group?
records.text: No, you cannot team up with other Spotify customers to sue the company as a group. The Terms of Service state that neither party may participate as a plaintiff, claimant, or class member in any class, collective, consolidated, private attorney general, or representative proceeding (whether in court or arbitration) [Spotify – Governing law, jurisdiction, class action waiver, and jury trial waiver].
cited_labels: [Spotify – Governing law, jurisdiction, class action waiver, and jury trial waiver]

records.question: How old do you need to be to open a Netflix account?
records.text: You need to be at least 18 years of age to open a Netflix account [Netflix – 1. The Netflix Service].

records.question: Can somebody who doesn't live with me use my Netflix plan?
records.text: Yes, someone who doesn't live with you can use your Netflix plan if you have an Extra Member account, which is available in certain countries. [Netflix – 1. The Netflix Service]

records.question: How long does Netflix hang on to my details?
records.text: Netflix retains your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in their Privacy Statement, which includes providing their service, administering their business, researching and improving their services, sending marketing messages, supporting advertisements, ensuring safety and security, and complying with laws [Netflix – Retention of Personal Information].

records.question: How long does Lyft store records of my past trips and payments?
records.text: Lyft stores records of your past trips and payments for at least seven years to ensure they can perform legitimate business functions, such as accounting for tax obligations [Lyft – How We Store and Protect Your Information].
cited_labels: [Lyft – How We Store and Protect Your Information]

records.question: Will Lyft charge me if I book a ride and never turn up?
records.text: Yes, Lyft may charge you if you book a ride and never turn up. A fee may apply if you fail to show up after requesting a ride [Lyft – Charges].

records.question: Can a 17 year old ride with Lyft?
records.text: Yes, a 17-year-old can ride with Lyft if they are using Rideshare Services, provided they are accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who has created a User account for them and meets the specified requirements [Lyft – Eligibility].

records.question: Is Lyft making money by selling my data?
records.text: Lyft does not sell your personal information to third parties for money [Lyft – How We Disclose Your Information].

records.question: What's the youngest age allowed on Discord?
records.text: The youngest age allowed on Discord is 13 years old [Discord – Age requirements and responsibility of parents and legal guardians].
cited_labels: [Discord – Age requirements and responsibility of parents and legal guardians]

records.question: Does Discord sell what it knows about me to advertisers?
records.text: Discord may share information with advertising platforms to help reach people that they think will like their products and to measure the performance of their ads shown on those platforms [Discord – How we disclose your information]. However, Discord does not make money from selling your personal information to third parties [Discord – A little bit about Discord].

records.question: What happens if a lot of people bring the same dispute against Discord at once?
records.text: If a lot of people bring the same dispute against Discord at once, the dispute may be resolved through arbitration, and the arbitration process may limit the ability to pursue claims as a class or representative action. This is due to the class-action waiver and the provisions regarding class arbitration and collective relief waiver [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord].
cited_labels: [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord]

records.question: Are kids allowed to have a Reddit account?
records.text: Children under the age of 13 are not allowed to create an account or otherwise use the Services [Reddit – Children].

records.question: What rights does Reddit get over the things I post?
records.text: Reddit gains the right to use your content globally. You retain ownership rights, but you grant Reddit a worldwide license to use your content. [Reddit – 5. Your Content]

records.question: How long does Reddit hold on to my IP address?
records.text: Reddit holds your IP address for up to 100 days after collection. [Reddit – What Information We Collect]

records.question: Will my paid Zoom plan keep billing me automatically?
records.text: Yes, your paid Zoom plan may keep billing you automatically. According to the Terms of Service, Zoom may charge your Payment Method for all Charges, including recurring fees, and unless otherwise specified, Charges are exclusive of Taxes and Fees [Zoom – 12. PAYMENTS AND CHARGES]. Additionally, if you have a recurring subscription, Zoom may automatically renew your subscription unless you opt out [Zoom – Effective Date: August 11, 2023].

records.question: Can other people read my Zoom Email messages?
records.text: Yes, other people can read your Zoom Email messages if they have access to the encryption key. Account owners and designated account administrators can access email and calendar content sent to and from users on their Zoom Email or Zoom Calendar accounts, even if those Zoom Emails are encrypted [Zoom – Who Can See, Share, and Process My Personal Data When I Join Meetings and Use Other Zoom Products and Services?].
cited_labels: [Zoom – Who Can See, Share, and Process My Personal Data When I Join Meetings and Use Other Zoom Products and Services?]

records.question: Is Zoom allowed to shut down a service I'm paying for?
records.text: Yes, Zoom may shut down a service you're paying for under certain circumstances. For example, if you fail to comply with any provision of the Agreement or any referenced policies, Zoom may suspend your access to the Services or terminate this Agreement [Zoom – 14. TERM; TERMINATION AND SUSPENSION]. Additionally, if you fail to pay Charges for five (5) calendar days following the due date, Zoom may terminate, suspend, or disconnect your Services immediately and without prior notice [Zoom – 12. PAYMENTS AND CHARGES].

records.question: Do I give up my right to a jury if I have a dispute with Coursera?
records.text: Yes, you give up your right to a jury if you have a dispute with Coursera. The Terms of Service include an arbitration agreement that waives your right to a jury trial [Coursera – Thank you for using Coursera!].

records.text: Not found in the documents

records.question: Could Coursera still have my data after I ask them to erase it?
records.text: Yes, Coursera may still have your data after you ask them to erase it. They may retain limited Personal Data where necessary for lawful and legitimate purposes, which may vary depending on your location, such as complying with legal obligations. Additionally, residual information may remain within their databases, access logs, or other records, which may or may not contain your Personal Data [Coursera – Your Rights].

records.question: Can a teenager sign up for their own PayPal account?
records.text: Yes, a teenager can sign up for their own PayPal account if they are at least 18 years old. If they are under 18, they cannot open a personal account and must have a guardian or legal representative open an account on their behalf [Paypal – Opening an account].

records.question: How long does PayPal keep my information once I stop being a customer?
records.text: PayPal retains your Personal Information for the duration of your relationship plus a period of 10 years or such period as mandated by any applicable local law once our relationship comes to an end, unless we need to keep it longer to the extent permitted by applicable law [Paypal – How Long We Store Your Personal Information].
cited_labels: [Paypal – How Long We Store Your Personal Information]

records.question: How much time do I have to get my money back from my bank for a PayPal SEPA debit?
records.text: You have up to 8 weeks to claim a refund from your bank for a PayPal SEPA Direct Debit payment [Paypal – Your continuous permission for us to charge your funding sources].
cited_labels: [Paypal – Your continuous permission for us to charge your funding sources]

records.question: What age do I need to be to join Strava?
records.text: To join Strava, you need to be at least 13 years old. If you are under the legal age to form a binding contract in your jurisdiction, your parent or legal guardian must review and agree to these Terms on your behalf [Strava – Registration and Accounts].

records.question: Can I get my Strava subscription money back?
records.text: Not found in the documents

records.question: Does Strava get paid for handing over my information?
records.text: Not found in the documents

records.question: If I close my Strava account, does my data actually go away?
records.text: Yes, when you close your Strava account, your personal information is permanently and irreversibly deleted from their systems, including backups. However, it may take up to 45 days to fully delete your personal information and system logs from their systems [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data]. Additionally, they may retain information to comply with the law, prevent fraud, collect fees, resolve disputes, troubleshoot problems, assist with investigations, enforce the Terms of Service, and take other actions permitted by law [Strava – Retention of Information].
cited_labels: [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data]

records.question: What can Pinterest do with the pictures I upload?
records.text: Pinterest can use the pictures you upload to show you content and ads on and off Pinterest that are relevant to you. They may also use your pictures to identify you and your interests [Pinterest – 1. The Service].

records.question: Does Pinterest use the websites I visit to show me ads?
records.text: Yes, Pinterest uses the websites you visit to show you ads. They disclose information such as cookie IDs, your IP address, and a hashed version of your email address to services they use to market Pinterest to you on sites and apps other than Pinterest [Pinterest – To deliver ads, off Pinterest, that are relevant, interesting and personal to you about Pinterest].
